title: Leading coefficient of a Krawtchouk sum
statement: For nonnegative integers $n,j$, let $(t)_r=\\prod_{s=0}^{r-1}(t-s)$ denote the falling factorial polynomial, with $(t)_0=1$. The sum, for $k=0,\\ldots,j$, of the leading coefficients of the polynomials $\\frac{(-1)^k}{k!}(t)_k\\,\\frac{1}{(j-k)!}(n-t)_{j-k}$ is $(-1)^j2^j/j!$.�
